trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unlock all other 54 trophies in Grand Theft Auto VI to earn the prestigious Platinum trophy. This requires completing the story, mastering all stranger strands, finding all collectibles, and winning all challenges. Not missable as trophies can be cleaned up post-game. Refer to the numbered route steps and district location hints to complete 'Vice Got a Price!' efficiently.
steps: 1. Vice City (Downtown & Ocean Beach): Review overall checklist and verify all 54 previous trophies are unlocked.
2. Before starting endgame activities, ensure you have completed all main story chapters in Leonida.
3. Travel to Starfish Island safehouse to check completion progress via the in-game terminal.
4. Complete any remaining missing side strands or uncollected items across Port Gellhorn and Grassrivers.
5. Re-check all missable story and stranger trophies to guarantee zero omissions.
6. Trigger the final cleanup task across Viceport to secure all remaining miscellaneous requirements.
7. Unlock the prestigious Platinum trophy 'Vice Got a Price!' upon receiving confirmation of 100% completion.
